# AetherTrigger

> AetherTrigger is a development-stage business-intelligence brand operated by Quant Data Intelligence LLC.

Official site: https://aethertrigger.com/
Parent company: https://www.quantdataintel.com/
Parent brand portfolio: https://www.quantdataintel.com/brands/
Founder: Alexandru Stoica — https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexstoicax/

Slogan: Turn aether signals into your next business opportunity.

AetherTrigger is intended for B2B providers serving Shopify and Shopify Plus merchants. It is in development; no live monitoring, alerting, subscription or product purchase is currently offered. It is independent of Shopify.

## Business identity
Quant Data Intelligence LLC; EIN 61-2355086 as furnished by the owner. Business mailing address: 30 N Gould St. Ste N, Sheridan, WY 82801, United States. Contact: hello@aethertrigger.com. Support: help@aethertrigger.com. Telephone: +1 (307) 900-1944.

## Audience and scope
Teams providing apps, integrations, consulting, technology or services for Shopify and Shopify Plus merchants. The intended product direction is to help recognize emerging market signals, prioritize opportunities and act with useful context. Features, data sources and service levels will be specified when actual products launch.

## Brand relationships
AetherTrigger and VerticalFoundry are separate brands of Quant Data Intelligence LLC. VerticalFoundry focuses on practical industry-specific systems for service-business owners. AetherTrigger explores business intelligence for merchant ecosystem service providers.

## Notes
References to Shopify and Shopify Plus describe a third-party ecosystem. No affiliation, endorsement or sponsorship is claimed. The logo used here is a approved Variant 2 raster PNG logo, not a native vector SVG.

The AetherTrigger About page presents founder Alexandru Stoica’s e-commerce experience and a careful approach to interpreting commercial signals, emphasizing judgment, uncertainty and the brand’s development-stage status.
